trigger_incident.reason: four content SHA-256 equivalence classes crossed allowed study splits

scope: create an independent P5V Python 3.11 environment
run exactly one fresh manifest-generation attempt

sequence: apply the original deterministic train1 10/30 subdivision
hash all entries in profile_calibration, effect_evaluation, and task_validation
group allowed entries by exact file-content SHA-256
if one SHA-256 occurs in more than one allowed study split, quarantine every member of that equivalence class
retain all non-quarantined entries in their original assigned split
record_required: every quarantined relative path, class, label, and original study split
replacement_rule.validity_gate: after quarantine, allowed splits must be pairwise path-disjoint and content-SHA-disjoint, and every one of the 47 classes must remain represented in each allowed split
replacement_rule.failure_action: first-error stop; publish no manifest; do not retry or alter the rule

claim_boundary: Administrative duplicate-quarantine amendment after a no-result manifest failure; not profiling, performance evidence, task evidence, or authorization to run P5V.
